title: gelsemium elegans
intro: Gelsemium elegans, commonly known as Chinese silktree or evening primrose, is a flowering plant species in the family Gelsemiaceae. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing anxiety and stress, promoting relaxation, and improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Gelsemium elegans are attributed to its sedative, anti-anxiety, and anti-inflammatory properties, which are thought to be due to the presence of bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. The main bioactive constituents of Gelsemium elegans include gelsemine, gelsemidine, and gelsemic acid, which have been shown to have neuroprotective and antioxidant effects.
